rules.statement: A decree of dismissal can operate as res adjudicata only where there is no legitimate doubt as to the issues which were involved in the decision on the facts that have been expressly or impliedly decided thereby.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where an action is dismissed of consent, the decree of dismissal can operate as res adjudicate only where there is no legitimate doubt as to the issues which were involved in the decision on the facts which have been expressly or impliedly decided thereby."
